messages.author: ecce7cb7d220285c
messages.subject: update()
parts:
I would like to update the lavaan object, "fit", shown below by adding "quant:=a*b" to the model syntax. Is there any way to use the update() function or any other functions in lavaan to add "quant:=a*b" to the model syntax and refit the model, e.g., update(fit, ...)? I could have created a new syntax using paste(model, "quant:=a*b", sep="\n"), but I wanted to use the "fit" object that I already have.

Thanks,

model <- ' 
  # latent variable definitions
     ind60 =~ x1 + x2 + x3
     dem60 =~ y1 + a*y2 + b*y3 + c*y4
     dem65 =~ y5 + a*y6 + b*y7 + c*y8

  # regressions
    dem60 ~ ind60
    dem65 ~ ind60 + dem60

  # residual correlations
    y1 ~~ y5
    y2 ~~ y4 + y6
    y3 ~~ y7
    y4 ~~ y8
    y6 ~~ y8
'

fit <- sem(model, data=PoliticalDemocracy)

messages.author: 5d4f9e7f97c21008
messages.subject: Re: update()
parts:
I don't believe update can be used to change model syntax currently. However, if you would like to update  the lavaan model with a constraint (or additional parameter that is a function of other parameters) you can use the constraints argument in the cfa/sem/lavaan function (or you could use this with the update function on a lavaan object).

Alex
